input.quote: ARTICLE III OWNERSHIP Licensee acknowledges that Licensor owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein.
input.rationale: Article III vests all ownership in Licensor and, read with the broad "DERIVATIVE WORK" definition (p0005) and the customization/enhancement work we commission and pay for under Article VII(b) (p0087), sweeps deliverables we fund into Licensor's property with only the narrow, terminable Field-of-Use licence and no licence-back. The Agreement is also entirely silent on ownership of our trading, order and client data, while "Intellectual Property Rights" and "Confidential Information" are defined one-way in Licensor's favour. Our playbook requires that we own deliverables created and paid for by us, that Vendor background IP embedded in them be licensed to us perpetually and royalty-free, and that we retain all rights in our data with no joint ownership. Licensor's ownership of its platform is preserved.

proposal.summary: Add Licensee ownership of its data and of paid-for customization deliverables, with licence-back for embedded Licensor IP and no joint ownership
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article III currently gives Licensor everything, including customization deliverables we pay for under Article VII(b), and the Agreement is silent on our trading and client data. We have added language confirming we own our data and pre-existing IP, that we own (or at minimum receive a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to) deliverables we fund, and that there is no joint ownership; Licensor's platform and background IP are untouched.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing: (a) Licensee retains all right, title and interest in and to all data and information submitted, transmitted, processed or generated by or on behalf of Licensee through the Licensed Technology, including its trade, order, position, market activity and client information ("Licensee Data"), and in and to Licensee's pre-existing intellectual property, and nothing in this Agreement operates as an assignment, transfer or licence to Licensor of any right, title or interest in Licensee Data or Licensee's intellectual property; (b) Licensee owns all customization work, deliverables and work product created for Licensee and paid for by Licensee, including pursuant to Article VII(b), and Licensor hereby assigns all right, title and interest in such deliverables to Licensee; (c) to the extent any Licensed Technology or other pre-existing intellectual property of Licensor is embedded in such deliverables, Licensor grants to Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense such embedded materials as part of the deliverables for Licensee's business purposes; and (d) no deliverable, work product or Licensee Data shall be jointly owned by the parties.
